reference.title: One setting to change who sees you (night glass walkthrough)
reference.notes: Speaker before a night city, glass people cards and audience bars, a white card that dives into a settings walkthrough with a blue touch dot, a country picker, a keypad, a magnifier, a top-10 card into a phone, a comment bar and a DM banner; heavy italic caps captions. Clone (ishaan-motion, real footage for the city and portraits, library sfx where the reference has none): data/refs/r5/clone-motion. Blind judge 7.0 vs R4's shipped sheet 4.8 in the same round.

parts.name: Live glass panel
parts.about: a rounded panel that blurs what is really behind it (the canvas under a blur filter), a dark tint, a top sheen and a thin light edge; arrives rising 40 px from 0.92 scale out of a blur

parts.name: People cards with view counters
parts.about: two portrait cards (real footage, desaturated) under PERSON B | PERSON A headers with a divider; an eye icon and a counter that rolls 36K to 100K

parts.name: Audience bars on glass
parts.about: a glass panel titled Audience with three country rows whose bars fill in a magenta gradient with a glow and percentages that count up, staggered

parts.name: Glowing touch dot
parts.about: a glossy blue dot with a soft halo that glides on an arc between targets and presses with a ring on each tap (keys: time, x, y, tap)

parts.name: Card from the hands dives into the screen
parts.about: a white card rises from the speaker's hands on its word, then grows in log space to fill the frame and becomes the first screen

parts.name: Settings walkthrough
parts.about: full-screen white app screens (profile, a scrolling settings list with line icons and scroll blur, a sub-page, a form) that slide in from the right on each tap

params.needsAsset: a real screen recording beats the drawn screens

parts.name: Crowd that turns half red
parts.about: a picker card over a near-black scrim; a 2x6 grid of glossy little people in a flag's colours pops in, then on the number the left half turns red and sinks back

parts.name: Keypad entry
parts.about: a numeric keypad slides up, each spoken digit's key flashes as the field fills, with a blinking caret

parts.name: Magnifier bubble
parts.about: a white circle springs out over the speaker carrying the one field that matters (a label and its value), as the UI dims into his backdrop

parts.name: Ruled top-10 card
parts.about: a ruled paper card (two-colour title, ten rows with flags writing in) springs up over the blurred speaker, then on the screenshot flash shrinks into a phone body

parts.name: Glass comment bar
parts.about: a glass pill with an avatar types the keyword letter by letter with a caret, and the blue send arrow pops

parts.name: DM banner
parts.about: a glass notification drops in with a gradient app tile, the sender, the line and 'now'

parts.name: Heavy italic caps phrases
parts.about: phrases of 2-5 words in a heavy italic caps face, each word landing on its stamp from 1.35x out of a blur, lines re-centring as words arrive; two lines when the phrase is long; shown only while the speaker carries the frame

parts.name: Footage backdrop behind the speaker
parts.about: real footage of a view (a city at night) far behind the speaker: defocused, darkened and cooled, with window mullions and a dark sofa band
